race.description: Allcoast Tyre Solutions Summer Scorcher Series Hcp (Bm68)
race.comment: CYBER CITY (18) only went under by only a head to SHADWELL LANE here last time. Had excuses there and now meets the winner with a nice pull at the weights. Can get the job done this time. SHADWELL LANE (10) is the obvious danger after and that was only first-up so she has plenty of scope for improvement. Keeps Thompson and is drawn favourably. Can repeat the dose. STEEL KNIGHT (16) has mixed his form since resuming and while he hasn't won for a long time, his peaks stack right up. Could only take on trust but he deserves some thought. OSCAR (8) has returned in terrific order with two barnstorming wins. Not much changes here and if the pace is genuine he can round them up again.
